soldier: Soldier head yellowish brown to pale chestnut brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.53–0.59, the lateral margins parallel, the posterior margin nearly broadly rounded, the frontal ridge slightly raised with the interfrontal area slightly concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent labral apex needle-pointed, with apical and subapical hairs but lacking lateral-apical hairs. The mandibles are strong, their apices rather curved, the curved apex short and slightly thick, the mandibular condyle indistinct; the mandibular length about 0.56 times the head capsule length and about 0.95–1.02 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region slender with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.56 times as wide as long, the middle of the anterior margin with a V-shaped shallow notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with about eight long hairs in the middle region.
